description: Labelled units for the judge. label=good: should reach memory; label=bad: should be held back. Credentials here are obvious placeholders, never real values.

context.title: Cache customer profile reads in Redis for 30 minutes
context.summary: Profile reads are served from Redis with a 30-minute TTL.

context.title: Send customer notifications synchronously from the portal API
context.summary: Notifications are sent inside the request that triggers them.

context.title: Payment gateway sandbox returns HTTP 200 for declined cards
context.summary: Read the status field instead of the HTTP code.

context.title: Refunds above 500 EUR require a second approver
context.summary: Large refunds need a second back-office approver.

item.title: Outbox worker acknowledges jobs before delivery
item.summary: Jobs are acked before the provider confirms, so outages lose emails.
item.body: In src/notifications/outboxWorker.ts move ack() after the provider returns 2xx.

item.title: Store uploaded documents in S3 with server-side encryption
item.summary: Customer documents go to a private KMS-encrypted bucket.
item.body: Uploads use presigned PUT URLs; the API never proxies file bytes and the bucket denies unencrypted puts.

item.title: Use idempotency keys on payment and refund POSTs
item.summary: Repeated requests with the same key replay the first response.
item.body: Clients send an Idempotency-Key header; keys are stored for 24 hours and a conflicting body returns 422.

item.title: Customers can download invoices for the last 24 months only
item.summary: Older invoices are archived and served on request.
item.body: InvoiceService.list() filters by issue date; archived invoices are restored by support within two days.

item.title: Public API responses never expose internal account flags
item.summary: Risk and fraud flags are stripped from public responses.
item.body: ProfileSerializer.toPublic() whitelists exposed fields; internal flags require the staff role.

item.title: Async notifications removed checkout timeouts during the campaign
item.summary: No checkout request timed out at peak after the outbox change.
item.body: Peak of 1,200 orders per minute; before the change 3% of checkouts timed out waiting for the provider.

item.title: Address validation API rejects postcodes with spaces
item.summary: Normalise postcodes before validating them.
item.body: The service at https://address.example/validate expects postcodes without spaces; strip them first.

cases.label: good
cases.note: true gotcha described without a concrete artefact (grounding false positive)

item.title: Redis eviction drops profile cache keys under memory pressure
item.summary: With an LRU policy the profile cache is evicted first during spikes.
item.body: During traffic spikes the cache node evicts profile entries first and the database load doubles. Size the node so the profile keys fit.

cases.label: good
cases.note: legitimate refinement of an existing decision (contradiction false positive)

item.title: Cache customer profile reads in Redis for 10 minutes
item.summary: Shorter TTL agreed with support so address changes appear sooner.
item.body: Keeps the read-through cache in ProfileService.get() and lowers the TTL from 30 to 10 minutes.

cases.label: good
cases.note: correct pattern whose body uses the word 'might' (hedge false positive)

item.title: Warm the profile cache after each deploy
item.summary: A post-deploy job preloads the most requested profiles.
item.body: The cache might be cold after a deploy, so the release pipeline runs warmCache() for the top 1,000 profiles.
